summary_zh: 本页为绘本《小麻雀不离开》的标题页，显示了书名、作者和插画师信息，下方有三只小麻雀在落叶中觅食的插图。

page_text_ocr_zh:
秋天到了！冬天也快要来临。许多鸟儿都在准备飞去温暖的地方过冬，只有小麻雀一点也不着急。

小麻雀，大家都在找东西吃、整理羽毛，准备飞到温暖的地方去。你怎么没有准备呢？

旅行前要换下用了一年的旧羽毛，换上全新的羽毛才行！

● 认识小麻雀
麻雀有夹杂着咖啡色、黑色和白色的羽毛，能帮助它躲在树木之间，不容易被发现。

脸上的黑色腮红，是麻雀独有的标记。

脚爪可以紧紧抓住树干和树枝，却不适合摊开来行走，所以麻雀在地上都用跳跃的方式前进。

有些鸟类冬天和夏天会住在不同的地方，称为“候鸟”；但是有些鸟儿一年到头都住在同一个地区，称为“留鸟”。小麻雀就是留鸟中的一种。

▲家燕
▼黄头鹭
page_text_en:
Autumn has arrived! Winter is coming soon. Many birds are preparing to fly to warm places for winter, but the little sparrow is not in a hurry at all.

Sparrow, everyone is looking for food, preening their feathers, and preparing to fly to warm places. Why aren't you preparing?

You need to shed your old feathers from the past year and grow brand new ones before traveling!

● Getting to Know the Sparrow
Sparrows have feathers mixed with coffee brown, black, and white, which help them hide among trees and avoid being noticed.

The black cheek patches on their faces are unique markings of sparrows.

Their claws can grip tree trunks and branches tightly, but are not suitable for walking flat-footed, so sparrows move forward by hopping on the ground.

Some birds live in different places during winter and summer, called 'migratory birds'; but some birds live in the same area all year round, called 'resident birds'. The little sparrow is one type of resident bird.

▲ Barn Swallow
▼ Yellow-headed Egret
summary_zh: 本页描绘了秋天到来时，许多鸟儿准备南飞过冬，而小麻雀却不着急。家燕和黄头鹭询问小麻雀为何不准备，小麻雀解释自己是留鸟，不需要迁徙。页面还介绍了小麻雀的外形特征和生活习性。

page_text_ocr_zh:
小麻雀不挑嘴
：小麻雀，跟我们一起飞去温暖的地方吧！冬天的时候，虫子都冻死了或是躲起来，根本找不到，如果不搬家，我们冬天一定会饿肚子。
春
冬
我们只爱昆虫，不喜欢吃种子或其他食物，只好到温暖的南方去过冬。
冬天，我们可以吃掉在地上的种子，所以不用担心饿肚子！
夏
秋
夏天我可以吃昆虫。
我们不怕人，冬天没有食物的时候，也敢靠近人，吃他们喂的面包屑或吃剩的食物。
冬天天气太冷，阳光又不够暖和，许多植物会落叶，甚至枯死，许多小昆虫也会跟着饿死或冻死。
麻雀属于杂食性鸟类，它的嘴巴又粗又短，非常适合吃小虫、果实和种子。
page_text_en:
Little Sparrows Don't Picky
: Little sparrow, come fly with us to a warm place! In winter, insects are frozen or hidden, impossible to find. If we don't move, we'll definitely starve in winter.
Spring
Winter
We only love insects, don't like seeds or other foods, so we must go to warm southern places for winter.
In winter, we can eat seeds on the ground, so we don't worry about being hungry!
Summer
Autumn
In summer, I can eat insects.
We are not afraid of people. When there's no food in winter, we dare to approach humans and eat the bread crumbs or leftover food they give us.
In winter, the weather is too cold, sunlight is not warm enough, many plants shed leaves or even die, and many small insects will starve or freeze to death.
Sparrows are omnivorous birds. Their beaks are thick and short, perfectly suited for eating insects, fruits, and seeds.
summary_zh: 本页通过四季场景展示小麻雀的饮食习性，解释其为何不挑食、不怕冬天，并与家燕等迁徙鸟类对比，说明其作为留鸟的生存策略。

page_text_ocr_zh:
小麻雀换上厚衣服
：小麻雀，跟我们一起走吧！冬天时，这里的天气会变得越来越冷，我们很可能会冻死的。
我们候鸟的翅膀长，能飞到很远的南方去过冬。
我的翅膀短，不适合飞很远到南方去过冬。
：别担心，冬天的时候，我会长出许多细细的绒毛，像换上厚衣服一样，就不怕冷了。
冬天来临前，小麻雀会长出较多的绒毛，帮助保暖，所以看起来会比夏天时胖一点。
冬天，我们会穿上保暖的羽绒衣，所以看起来比夏天胖。
page_text_en:
Little Sparrow Puts on Thick Clothes
: Little sparrow, come with us! In winter, the weather here will get colder and colder, and we might freeze to death.
Our migratory birds have long wings and can fly to distant southern places to spend the winter.
My wings are short, not suitable for flying far to the south for winter.
: Don't worry, in winter, I will grow many fine downy feathers, like putting on thick clothes, so I won't be afraid of the cold.
Before winter arrives, little sparrows grow more downy feathers to keep warm, so they look a bit fatter than in summer.
In winter, we put on warm down jackets, so we look fatter than in summer.
summary_zh: 本页通过对话形式，解释了小麻雀作为留鸟为何不随候鸟南飞过冬，以及它如何通过长出更多绒毛来适应寒冷的冬天，看起来比夏天更胖。

page_text_ocr_zh:
小麻雀住在城市里
：小麻雀，这里的冬天常常下雨，还有冷飕飕的坏天气，你要躲到哪里去呢？
下雨的时候，我会和同伴靠在一起取暖，或是躲进屋檐下和缝隙里，等天气变好再出去！
：不用担心。我们麻雀不怕人，可以住在人类生活的都市里。都市里比田野或森林温暖多了。
有人类居住的地方，冷风会被房子挡住，车辆、电器或煤气炉也会排出热气，所以住在人类生活的都市里比野外温暖。
砖块、篱笆和屋瓦上，也常常可以看见麻雀的踪影。这里都是小麻雀遮风避雨的地方。
page_text_en:
Sparrows Live in the City
: Sparrow, the winter here often rains and has cold, unpleasant weather. Where will you hide?
When it rains, I will huddle with my companions to keep warm, or hide under eaves and in crevices, waiting for the weather to improve before going out!
: Don't worry. We sparrows are not afraid of humans and can live in urban areas where people live. Cities are much warmer than fields or forests.
Where humans live, cold winds are blocked by buildings, and vehicles, appliances, or gas stoves also emit heat, so living in human-inhabited cities is warmer than in the wild.
On bricks, fences, and rooftops, you can often see sparrows. These are all places where sparrows shelter from wind and rain.
summary_zh: 本页通过对话和插图，解释了小麻雀为何选择住在城市里，因为城市有房屋、车辆和电器等能提供温暖，帮助它们在冬天避寒，砖块、篱笆和屋瓦也是它们遮风避雨的好地方。

page_text_ocr_zh:
小麻雀的冬天
决定搬到温暖南方去的鸟儿们，都飞走了。小麻雀和
同伴们开心地留下来。冷的时候，就和同伴们挤在一起取
暖；饿的时候，就捡地上的种子或人类吃剩的食物来吃。

阳光能让麻雀的身体变温暖，还
能晒干它们身上的羽毛。这样，
羽毛就能变得更蓬松，保暖效果
也会更好。

趁天气好，多找
些种子来吃吧！

阳光好温暖，
好舒服！

如果幸运遇上有太阳的好天气，
麻雀就会飞出去晒晒太阳，或
是用又干又热的沙子，把湿湿
冷冷的羽毛洗干净。

麻雀除了用水洗澡以外，还会用沙子洗澡，这叫“沙
浴”。当冬天的太阳把沙子晒得干干热热的时候，麻
雀就会用沙子清洗身体，把身上的寄生虫赶走。
page_text_en:
The Sparrow's Winter
The birds that decided to move to the warm south have all flown away. The sparrows and their companions happily stay behind. When it's cold, they huddle together to keep warm; when they're hungry, they pick up seeds or leftover food from humans.

Sunlight can warm the sparrows' bodies and dry their feathers. This way, their feathers become fluffier, and the insulation effect is better.

[One sparrow says:] Let's take advantage of the good weather and find some seeds to eat!

[Another sparrow says:] The sunshine is so warm, so comfortable!

If lucky enough to have sunny weather, sparrows will fly out to bask in the sun, or use dry, hot sand to clean their damp, cold feathers.

Besides bathing in water, sparrows also bathe in sand, which is called a 'sand bath'. When the winter sun dries the sand hot and dry, sparrows use the sand to clean their bodies and drive away parasites.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了小麻雀在冬天的生活，它们不随候鸟南飞，而是留在原地，通过挤在一起取暖、捡食种子和人类剩食来度过寒冬。在晴天，它们会晒太阳或进行沙浴，以保持羽毛干燥蓬松并清除寄生虫。

page_text_ocr_zh:
和小麻雀一起过冬的鸟朋友
虽然小麻雀的有些朋友离开了，但是也有一些鸟儿留下来，像鸽子、白头翁和绿绣眼，还是常会和小麻雀一起，出现在公园里、城市中。所以，即使是在寒冷的冬天里，小麻雀也一点都不会觉得孤单。

□ 白头翁、绿绣眼和麻雀，是城镇或都市里最常见的三种留鸟。它们经常聚在一起，在树丛间觅食。

鸽子是人类饲养的，所以冬天里，主人会为它们提供温暖的鸽笼和充足的食物，不必去南方过冬。

太好了，冬天有你们陪我留下来，我一点都不寂寞了！

白头翁、绿绣眼和麻雀一样，属于杂食性鸟类，春夏爱吃昆虫，秋冬则改吃果实和种子。所以即使冬天留下来，它们也不会饿肚子。

▶ 白头翁的眼睛后方到头顶，有一大块白斑，好像白头发的老人一样，所以叫作白头翁。

◀ 绿绣眼的身材娇小，眼睛四周围绕的白色圈圈，是绿绣眼最大的特点。
page_text_en:
Bird Friends Who Winter with the Sparrow
Although some of the sparrow's friends have left, some birds stay behind, like pigeons, white-eyes, and green-eyed birds, who often appear with the sparrow in parks and cities. So, even in the cold winter, the sparrow never feels lonely.

□ White-eyes, green-eyed birds, and sparrows are the three most common resident birds in towns or cities. They often gather together, foraging among the bushes.

Pigeons are raised by humans, so in winter, their owners provide them with warm pigeon coops and plenty of food, so they don't need to go south for winter.

Great! With you all staying with me this winter, I'm not lonely at all!

White-eyes, green-eyed birds, and sparrows are all omnivorous birds. In spring and summer, they eat insects; in autumn and winter, they switch to fruits and seeds. So even if they stay during winter, they won't go hungry.

▶ The white-eye has a large white patch from behind its eye to the top of its head, like an old person with white hair, hence the name 'white-eye'.

◀ The green-eyed bird is small in size, and the white ring around its eyes is its most distinctive feature.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了与小麻雀一起过冬的鸟朋友，包括鸽子、白头翁和绿绣眼，解释了它们作为留鸟在城市中共同生活的原因，并通过对话和图文说明了它们的外形特征和饮食习性。

This children's song uses a lot of jazz harmonies, and adds common brass instruments in big bands, such as trumpets, trombones, as well as pianos, jazz drums, and basses, to create more varied timbres. Rhythmically, it uses the swing style of jazz, making the whole piece sound lighter and faster. When singing, children can sway their bodies left and right to the rhythm, and enjoy the unique groove of this children's song.
summary_zh: 本页以儿歌形式描绘了小麻雀活泼可爱的形象和生活场景，通过插图和文字展示了它摇摆、歌唱、晒太阳、吃食等行为，并附有给家长的音乐说明，解释儿歌的爵士风格和演唱建议。
本页插图描绘了多只小麻雀在绿草地上活动的场景，它们或站立、或低头觅食，画面生动展现了小麻雀在自然环境中的活泼姿态。
